lines.text: The LORD asks Job whether he can satisfy the hunger of young lions, and who provides food for the raven.
The LORD made the wilderness the wild donkey's home, and he roams the mountains searching for any green thing.
The ostrich leaves her eggs on the ground to warm in the sand, and God has deprived her of courage.
The war horse charges into battle, laughs at fear, and cannot stand still when the harp sounds.
Job answers the LORD that he is insignificant and places his hand over his mouth.
